title: Application of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company (1) under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 199, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a chnage in the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of November and December 1985 and January, 1986. The Fuel Charge reflects change in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuel and power purchased by the Company; and (2) for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utilties Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
